params.body:
Saturday morning is by appointment. Opening-hours lines had only a label, days and two times, so there was nowhere to say that. Each line can now carry a short text.

## What changes

- **`Pages::hoursNote()`** returns the line's `note` in the current language, or `''`. The note is Sanity's `openingHoursEntry.note` (localeString), added to the Studio in ShaneDeconinck/schoutteet-sanity (branch `workbench/hours-note`).
- **Footer:** the note sits under the day in small type. The row aligns on the baseline so the times stay level with the day.
- **Contact page and the seller card on a vehicle page:** the note follows the times in brackets, "Zaterdag: 07:30 – 12:00 (op afspraak)". The contact meta description includes it.
- **Built-in hours** (fallback, and the seed export): Saturday 07:30 to 12:00 with "op afspraak", translated in de/en/fr/es.

The live hours stay in Sanity. Until the Saturday line is added in the Studio, the site shows what Sanity holds today (Monday to Friday).

Structured data (`openingHoursSpecification`) lists every line as before, Saturday included, since schema.org has no way to mark hours as by appointment.

## Checks

- `tests/Feature/OpeningHoursTest.php`: built-in Saturday with its note in nl and en; a note from a Sanity document in nl and fr; a line without a note gets no brackets.
- Screenshots of the footer (nl, es, fr at 1440 and 390), the contact block and the seller card.
- `php artisan test`: 63 passed
- `vendor/bin/pint --test`: passed
params.title: Opening hours: optional text per line, Saturday by appointment
